## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'

## Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Screenshots or Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, screen recordings, or browser console logs to help explain your problem.

## Environment & Device
Please complete the following information:
- **Device:** [e.g. Desktop PC, iPhone 14, Samsung Galaxy S23]
- **OS:** [e.g. Windows 11, macOS Sonoma, iOS 17, Android 14]
- **Browser:** [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Brave]
- **Browser Version:** [e.g. 122.0]

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., room name, single room or /me room, guest or admin, network conditions).
